notes: PROPOSED 2026-09-09 by the treasury-coupon-announcement-2026-12-24 never-assessed initial research, which owns the announcement that sizes this auction. WHY IT IS A GAP AND NOT A DUPLICATE: this calendar already tracks the 2-Year's September, October and November auctions (treasury-2y-note-2026-09-22, -2026-10-26, -2026-11-23) and the January one (treasury-2y-note-2027-01-25); December is the missing member of an established monthly series. WHAT MAKES IT WORTH ITS OWN ROW, and it is the reason the proposing research exists: this is the compressed leg. The 2-Year and the 5-Year auction in the SAME SESSION on 2026-12-28 — the only 2-session month-end block in the schedule's window — and the proposing session measured that compression as this calendar's first non-null. Block-level across 125 blocks since 2015, the 2Y/5Y pair in a compressed block averages z -0.237 vs +0.062 (t=-1.42, not significant over the full sample; t=-2.67 from 2020-05 onward, n=7 and t=-1.75 in the current size regime), while the 7-Year placebo — the leg that does NOT share a session — shows nothing in any window (t=-0.17). Whoever researches this auction should score that hypothesis rather than re-derive it, and should read the sign flip pre-2020 (n=4) as uninformative rather than as a contradiction. SIZE EXPECTATION, carried not derived: $69B. sb0590's 2-Year column reads 69 in all six published rows (May-26 through Oct-26) and the tape has not moved it since 2024-04-23 — 28 auctions, 28 months, nine refundings. Pool bid-to-cover mean is 2.686 (n=130 since 2015); the 2024-05-onward observed floor is 2.41. THE DIRECT PRECEDENT is 2020-12-28, a row-for-row calendar twin (same Christmas-Eve announcement, same shared Monday session, same 12-31 settlement, because December 2020 and December 2026 share a weekday layout), which printed 2.45 — z -0.97.
